name: open-feed
description: Reference implementations for the Open Feed Protocol (src/ for open-feed-spec.md, src2/ for open-feed-spec-2.md)

scripts.check: npm test && node tmp/regen.js && node tmp/regen2.js && node tmp/rules.js --gate && node tmp/check-prototypes.js && npm run gates
scripts.gates: sh -c 'for f in tmp/redesign/gates/*-gate.js; do node "$f" >/dev/null || { echo "RED: $f"; exit 1; }; done; echo "all gates green"'
